title: 사립학교보조와원조에관한건 / queue:ADDENDUM:00779:20010131:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDA (Enforcement Rules of the Organization of the Ministry of Education and Human Resources Development and Its Affiliated Agencies) <No. 779, January 31, 2001>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.

Article 2 Omitted.

Article 3 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations) (1) through (24) Omitted.

(25) The Decree on Subsidies and Assistance for Private Schools is amended as follows:

In Article 2 (1) and (2), the main clause and proviso of Article 4 (1), the main clause of Article 4 (2), and the main clause, subparagraph 5, and paragraph (2) of Article 5 (1), the term "Minister of Education" shall be replaced, respectively, with "Minister of Education and Human Resources Development".

(26) through (41) Omitted.
